thread:
Jordan Lee: Patricia handed in her resignation this morning; last working day is 1850025600 (two weeks). Need to plan COBRA notice, final paycheck, asset return, and account deprovision.
Patricia Gomez: I'm available for handoffs. I travel for a conference next week so would prefer a prepaid label for the laptop.
Jordan Lee: Noted. Key items: COBRA timing, PTO payout rules, final paycheck date, email forwarding, Okta/Slack/GCP access removal timing, shipping label for hardware.
Benefits: Coverage usually ends end-of-month by default. We'll prepare the COBRA packet and email it within 7 business days after HR processes the separation. Election window is 60 days.
IT Ops: We'll generate a prepaid shipping label and send instructions. Deprovision plan is to revoke console roles + SSO at 06:00 UTC the morning after last day, leave email forwarding for 30 days. If Patricia needs a brief overlap for service account handoff, tag the ticket with "soa-transfer".
Patricia Gomez: I have two service accounts and one personal-scope AWS key embedded in a script. I'll remove the personal key today and open a ticket to transfer ownership of the service accounts.
Jordan Lee: Please put a one-page handoff doc in /team-handovers/patricia-offboard and mention any active PRs and on-call notes.
Patricia Gomez: Done. Uploaded the handoff doc and added repo links.
offboard-bot: Automated offboard checklist created and assigned: Jordan (manager sign-off), IT Ops (label + deprovision), Benefits (COBRA packet), Patricia (hand-off doc). Exit interview scheduled tentatively.
Benefits: Payroll determines PTO payout timing; we'll confirm whether unused PTO will be included on the final paycheck and reply by EOD tomorrow.
IT Ops: Shipping label will be emailed within 48 hours. Please follow packing instructions and include the signed asset form or scanned copy. We'll audit the device when it arrives.
Jordan Lee: Recap actions: Benefits to confirm final pay/PTO, IT Ops to send label and run credential sweep on deprovision, Patricia to remove personal creds and confirm last active day, offboard-bot to send exit survey.
Patricia Gomez: Last active working day confirmed = 1850025600. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.
Jordan Lee: Closing loop once payroll confirms final pay. If anything else pops up, flag it here. :thumbsup:
